title: Vivid Smoky Irish Bresaola Hash
description: A smoky and crisp Irish dish featuring bresaola, perfect for a light meal, made easily in a wok with a dash of friendly ingredients and a touch of ferment for added depth.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to caramelize, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the wok, stirring to combine.
Cook for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender and lightly browned.
Add the sliced bell peppers to the wok and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped sauerkraut and cook for 1 minute.
Add the thinly sliced bresaola to the wok and stir to combine with the other ingredients.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the bresaola is heated through.
Serve the hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
